fod-strip.text: Horizontal three-panel digital-first fantasy-office cartoon strip, clean and readable. Consistent clean near-white masthead/header row: left side reads exactly 'The Forces of Darkness, LLC.' in prominent left-aligned type; right side reads exactly 'by Star Splitter Visions' in smaller right-aligned type. Individual strip title is subordinate, positioned under the main title at left. Keep both edges legible with generous padding, never centered or placed over the story panels. CANONICAL MASTER GEOMETRY: 3600 x 1800 pixels overall (2:1 landscape). Reserve an uninterrupted clean near-white masthead across x=0..3599, y=0..299 (300 px, 1/6 of canvas). Below it, arrange precisely THREE separate 1200 x 1500 px panels, each 4:5 portrait: panel 1 crop [x=0,y=300,width=1200,height=1500], panel 2 [x=1200,y=300,width=1200,height=1500], panel 3 [x=2400,y=300,width=1200,height=1500]. Keep all required story art and lettering wholly inside its respective panel. No cross-panel balloons or overlapping panels, no outer gutters between panel crops; draw any borders INSIDE each crop. Preserve crop-safe margins around dialogue and faces, so each panel reads as a standalone mobile portrait image. Derived images consist of the three panel rectangles only, without masthead; add optional mobile branding separately, not over the crop. If generated below the target resolution, preserve the exact 2:1 and three 4:5 proportions during mastering before using these pixel crop coordinates. DIGITAL-FIRST COLOR GRADE: Polished contemporary 2D webcomic / animation-cel finish optimized for bright phone and tablet screens. Keep the established approved character hue identities and clean silhouettes; enrich color separation with lively but controlled saturation, rich aubergine and burgundy shadows, clean olive and forest greens, warm dragon reds, selective teal and golden accents. Use clean solid fills with crisp two-value cel shadows, subtle ambient bounce and sparing highlights; bold outlines, near-white speech balloons, high-contrast near-black lettering. Retain clear midtones and shadow detail; keep faces, gestures and the actual sinister workplace readable at mobile size. Avoid washed-out, gray, brownish or uniformly muted colors, muddy shadows, crushed blacks, overexposure and excessive neon. No yellowed or aged paper, sepia wash, CMYK simulation, newsprint texture, halftone dots, faded ink, grain, ink bleed, printing artifacts, vignette or vintage print patina. Avoid photorealism, glossy 3D and painterly gradients. Master for clean sRGB screen presentation. Bold inked outlines, clean repeatable silhouettes, deliberate crisp cel shadows, readable deadpan acting, spacious unobstructed speech balloons. Preserve body-size hierarchy (Hork far larger than Eric), established outfits, and exact supplied dialogue and speaker ownership. The evil occupation, dungeon, curses, raids or army infrastructure remains visibly real. Keep a balanced comic rhythm; let the final panel deliver the authored reversal. Each strip stands alone, without invented story continuity.
